description: Unofficial read-only MCP server exposing several Mercury banking organizations to one AI session.
name: io.github.dkaleganov/mercury-multiorg-mcp

environmentVariables.description: Example only. Each organization needs one read-only Mercury API token in the environment variable named by its token_env in your registry. Names are yours to choose but must match MERCURY_TOKEN_[A-Z0-9_]+ (for example MERCURY_TOKEN_<ENTITY_KEY>); set one per organization and rename this example to match.
environmentVariables.name: MERCURY_TOKEN_ACME_MAIN

environmentVariables.description: Alternative to --entities: path to the entity registry YAML. Ignored when --entities is passed.
environmentVariables.name: MERCURY_ENTITIES_FILE

environmentVariables.description: Mercury API host. Allowed without extra flags: https://api.mercury.com, https://api-sandbox.mercury.com (with sandbox tokens), or a loopback mock.
environmentVariables.name: MERCURY_API_BASE

environmentVariables.description: Set to true to register get_statement_pdf and get_invoice_pdf, which return statement and invoice PDFs unredacted. Off by default.
environmentVariables.name: MERCURY_ALLOW_DOCUMENTS

packageArguments.description: Path to your private entity registry YAML: one entry per Mercury organization with key, display_name, and token_env (the environment variable holding that organization's read-only token). The MERCURY_ENTITIES_FILE environment variable is an alternative; this flag wins.
packageArguments.name: --entities

packageArguments.description: Optional private dotenv file loaded before tokens are resolved; existing environment variables win. Without this flag no dotenv file is read.
packageArguments.name: --env-file
